name: device-control-agent
description: A specialist agent that resolves an ambiguous or multi-device request into concrete device commands, checks each device is capable of what was asked, and reports what it actually did. Also reads current device state and sensor history.

skills.name: Orchestrate several devices
skills.description: Carry out a request that spans several devices or rooms, working out which devices are involved and in what order, then reporting per-device results including any that could not comply.
examples: Set the living room and bedroom lights to 30% warm white
Turn off everything in the kitchen
Make the living room comfortable for reading

skills.name: Resolve capability and disambiguate
skills.description: Work out whether a device can do what was asked, pick the right device when the request names a room or a category rather than a device, and explain the closest thing that is possible when it is not.

skills.name: Inspect device state and history
skills.description: Read what devices are doing right now and how a sensor metric has moved over a time window, then summarise it — including which devices have reported nothing.
examples: Which devices are on right now?
Has the air quality been getting worse today?
Is anything in the kitchen still running?
